notes: Ratings assume a properly equipped vehicle with required equipment and a 150-lb. driver and passenger; they vary with cargo, configuration, accessories, option content and number of passengers.
Do not exceed 5,000 lbs. when towing with bumper only (p.22-24).
Do not exceed 6,000 lbs. (3.3L, 2.7L) or 7,000 lbs. (5.0L, 3.5L, Hybrid) with only the Class IV hitch (53B), without Trailer Tow Package (53A) (p.22-24 footnotes).

Required equipment: trailers over 5,000 lbs. need Trailer Tow Package (53A, 53B) or Max Trailer Tow Package (53C); Lightning over 5,000 lbs. (standard range) or 7,700 lbs. (extended range) needs Trailer Tow Package (53D) (p.17).
53A/53B include a 2" receiver rated at 11,600 lbs.; 53C includes a 2" reinforced receiver rated at 14,000 lbs. (p.44).
Hitch receiver (p.44): weight-carrying 5,000 lbs./500 tongue; weight-distributing 14,000 lbs./1,400 tongue (Lightning 10,000/1,000; Raptor 8,200/820; Raptor R 8,700/870).
Frontal area (p.17): 55 sq. ft. for ratings 5,001-7,700 lbs., 60 sq. ft. for 7,701 lbs. and greater, 75 sq. ft. 5th-wheel/gooseneck; Lightning 40/55/60 sq. ft. by battery and 53D.
Tongue load should be 10% of loaded trailer weight; calculated with SAE J2807.
F-150 5th-wheel/gooseneck tables are printed in this guide but were not transcribed here; 5th-wheel towing is not recommended for Raptor or Lightning.
